name: Everinbox
description:
Everinbox connects Claude to your Everinbox account and turns email marketing into a conversation. Ask in plain language and Claude does the work through the official MCP connector, always within what your role already lets you see and do.
  
What you can do:
  • Campaigns: draft, schedule, and send regular, A/B, and recurring campaigns; check audience size before it goes out; cancel or duplicate.
  • Templates: build and edit email HTML with merge tags and personalization; generate Spintax variations to protect deliverability on repeated sends.
  • Audience: create and preview segments (engagement, RFM, domain, custom fields), build lists, import and organize contacts and tags.
  • Deliverability: read Postmaster signals like spam rate, domain reputation, bounces, and campaign metrics (opens, clicks, unsubscribes).
  • Push & automations: inspect and adjust push campaigns and automation flows.

Access is per-user via OAuth: you sign in with your own Everinbox account and Claude sees exactly the enterprises and projects you have a role in, nothing more. Actions that touch a real inbox or destroy data (creating a campaign, cancelling, deleting, moving contacts in bulk, editing a live automation) always ask for explicit confirmation and show you the audience, local time, template, and sender first.

Everinbox is an email marketing platform operated by Everinbox Tecnologia e Informação Ltda. (Brazil), LGPD-compliant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Everinbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Everinbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://core.mcp.everinbox.com.br/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Everinbox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everinbox lists 129 MCP tools, including add-contacts-to-tag, add-push-domain, analyze-template-variations, apply-segment-frequency-cap-preset, apply-template-variations, archive-segments, assign-tags-to-contacts, cancel-campaign, connect-postmaster, create-automation, create-automation-node, and create-automation-nodes-batch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Everinbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Everinbox in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Everinbox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Everinbox is developed by Everinbox. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
